end.summary:
Practised average speed using total distance ÷ total time, including a journey with different outward and return times.
Used direction to distinguish velocity from speed and applied velocity = displacement ÷ time.
Introduced acceleration a = (v − u)/t, including a negative result during braking.
Diya continued to associate acceleration mainly with speeding up; this was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: The mix-up that acceleration only means speeding up remained at the end; at home, ask Diya to describe one speeding-up and one braking example, including the sign of acceleration.
